official: 火災予防条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 林野火災の注意報と火の使用制限を新設
summary: 現在の条例には、林野火災の注意報に関する規定はありません。この改正で、注意報が出た区域では、火の使用制限に従うよう努めることを定めます。林野火災を防ぐための警報中の制限と、火を使う行為の届け出対象も追加します。施行日は2026年4月1日です。
changes: 林野火災の注意報を出せるようにする
注意報が出た区域では火の使用制限に従うよう努めることを定める
林野火災を防ぐための警報中は、屋外で裸火を使い火の粉を飛ばす行為を制限する
森林計画の対象区域で1月から5月に行う、火の粉が飛ぶ裸火の使用を届け出の対象に加える
who: 注意報や警報の対象区域で火を使う人
森林計画の対象区域で1月から5月に裸火を使い、火の粉を飛ばす人
why: 林野火災を防ぐための規定をより有効にするためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Adds wildfire advisories and restrictions on using fire
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Fire Prevention Ordinance
en.summary: The current ordinance has no provisions on wildfire advisories. This amendment provides that people in areas where an advisory has been issued should make efforts to comply with restrictions on the use of fire. It also adds restrictions during warnings to prevent wildfires and adds activities involving the use of fire to the activities that must be reported. It takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Allows wildfire advisories to be issued
Sets out that people in areas where an advisory has been issued should make efforts to comply with restrictions on the use of fire
Restricts the outdoor use of open flames that send sparks flying during wildfire-prevention warnings
Adds the use of open flames that send sparks flying in areas covered by a forest plan from January through May to the activities requiring notification
who: People who use fire in areas covered by an advisory or warning
People who use open flames that send sparks flying in areas covered by a forest plan from January through May
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says this is to make the provisions for preventing wildfires more effective.
